creator: Howard only after exact policy approval
original_deadline: admission_monotonic + 8100 seconds, fixed once; separate 1800-second issuance-to-admission validity. Never extended by timeout, repair, count call, cleanup or controller restart.
storage: Exclusive controller-owned directory outside repo, CI, model/candidate roots; owner-only; controller memory only; no environment secret inheritance
retirement: One-use nonce consumed before side effects; credential erased by Howard after terminal closeout/expiry; record public identifier hash and disposal acknowledgement only
secret_disclosure: No credentials or raw secret hashes in Release, chat, model context or candidate environment
admission_validity: 0 <= admission_wall_time - issued_at <= 1800; future issuance or expired issuance refuses before side effects
byte_policy_sha256: Literal STRICT until an exact per-run byte-policy decision is bound; otherwise a lowercase SHA256 of that exact policy document
response_completion: Only a fully complete, schema-valid response can succeed. Incomplete, truncated, partial, missing-final-event or malformed responses fail and consume the slot; no continuation, replacement or retry.
feedback: Only verdict-class counts under the exact feedback schema to analysis/repair; no case IDs/names, fields, bytes, error strings, paths, case order or per-case timing
